newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends up, seen rangebound nearterm.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends up, seen rangebound nearterm.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures settled barely higher amid a lack of fundamental inspiration and a neutral technical outlook, market sources said.
The March contract set its range early and then drifted throughout the day in thin dealings. Light trade buying and some speculative selling was noted.
"There was some trade buying on the open that ran into a huge wall of selling above the market," Sharon Johnson, an analyst with Frank Schneider and Co Inc, said.
Activity is not expected to pick up until the U.S. Department of Agriculture releases its monthly suppy and demand estimates Feb 12.
The spot March contract ended 0.05 firmer at 75.00 cents, traded 75.32 to 74.45. The back months settled 0.12 lower to 0.30 firmer.
Volume was estimated at 6,000 lots compared with Friday's official volume of 5,683 lots.
